# TSLA Analysis — 10:50 AM ET

---

## 1. MARKET SCENARIO

TSLA has surged ~3.7% on the day and is pressing directly against its 20D resistance at $357.79 — which is also the current price, meaning it is AT resistance with Bollinger Band position at 0.985 (essentially at the upper band). The most plausible scenario over the next 5-15 days is a short-term consolidation or modest pullback from this resistance zone before any continuation, as stochastics are deeply overbought (91.6), OBV is falling (distribution into the rally), and volume today is only 0.59x the 20D average (weak volume on a resistance test). A clean break and hold above $358-360 could trigger a run toward $370-380; failure here likely means a drift back toward $342-350.

---

## 2. BULL CASE

- **1H Bias is BULLISH (3B/1Br) + Price above VWAP on all timeframes**: TSLA is holding above VWAP on the 5m ($356.94), 15m ($354.60), and 1H ($350.91) simultaneously — this is the strongest short-term structural signal available and confirms intraday buyers remain in control.

- **XLY sector green (+0.70%) + 20D return of +15.71%**: TSLA is in a confirmed intermediate uptrend with sector tailwind — the tape favors the long side broadly.
- **Analyst consensus BUY with price target $395.34**: ~10.5% upside to analyst consensus provides a longer-horizon anchor; not a 0-2 DTE driver, but it removes the "fighting the tape" risk on calls.

---

## 3. BEAR CASE

- **AT THE UPPER BOLLINGER BAND (0.985) AND 20D RESISTANCE ($357.79)**: Price is literally at its ceiling on two simultaneous measures — this is a mean-reversion setup trigger, not a momentum continuation setup.
